fluff.overview: ComStar's infantry served across the Inner Sphere in garrison and security roles, stationed on HPG compound worlds where they provided protection for the Order's most critical infrastructure while maintaining the facade of a purely defensive force. Motorized platoons use light vehicles to achieve ground speeds well beyond foot infantry, allowing rapid redeployment between defensive positions. Their wheeled or motorcycle transport keeps the formation mobile on developed road networks, though off-road performance is limited. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
